list.title: Purchase orders
list.emptyBody: A purchase order asks a supplier for stock, such as crates of eggs.
list.error: Purchase orders could not be loaded
list.denied: You do not have access to purchase orders

fields.expectedOnHint: Optional. The day the supplier says it will arrive.
fields.expectedBefore: The expected day cannot be before the order date.

new.title: New purchase order
new.hint: Saving makes a draft. The prices, tax and totals are worked out by the server and shown before you submit it.
new.notSaved: The purchase order was not saved

detail.notFound: There is no purchase order at this address
detail.error: This purchase order could not be loaded
detail.pendingBody: This order is above the amount you can approve. Another person approves it in Approvals before it can be sent.

actions.submitBody: Within your limit it is approved at once; above it, it waits for another person to approve.
actions.sendBody: {{supplier}} is sent the order with these lines and this total.
actions.cancelBody: Nothing has been received against it. The reason goes in the audit log.
actions.closeBody: What is still to come stays recorded as never delivered. The reason goes in the audit log.
actions.denied: You cannot do this to purchase orders

outcome.submitted: Approved. It can be sent to the supplier.
outcome.awaiting: Sent for approval. It can be sent to the supplier once approved.
